name: nova-surge-toss
description: NOVA SURGE 앱인토스(Apps in Toss) 빌드 — ../slice/index.html 을 입력으로 .ait 번들을 만든다

scripts.build:toss: node scripts/prepare.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/scan.mjs --channel test && ait build && node scripts/stamp.mjs test
scripts.build:toss:release: node scripts/prepare.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode release && node scripts/scan.mjs --channel release && ait build && node scripts/stamp.mjs release
